info.title: FitTracker API
info.description: Workout + nutrition tracker API shared by web and mobile.

get.summary: List foods (shared library + user's custom), max 100
Get (or create) the food log for a date

post.summary: Add a food entry to a day
Start a workout session (optionally from a template)

put.summary: Update/finish a session and bulk-update sets

post.summary: Add a set to a session
AI nutrition label extraction from a photo (Server-Sent Events stream)

200.description: SSE stream. Each event is `data: {status: 'processing'|'completed'|'error', message?, result?}`. On completion, result = {name, servingSizeG, cal, fatG, carbG, proteinG, typicalG}.

post.summary: Get a presigned upload URL for cloud storage
Create an email/password account (web; mobile should use /api/mobile-auth/signup)
Validate email/password (no session issued; mobile should use /api/mobile-auth/login)
Create an account and return a bearer token.

user.description: The signed-in user from NextAuth's session.

409.description: An account with that email already exists.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a bearer token.

get.summary: The user for the supplied bearer token.
